title: The Palace of Deep Time
subject: The twelve periods of the Phanerozoic, oldest first
prompt: I can't remember the geological eras, can you generate a wacky thing that will stick in my head that I can use to walk through the set
style: bold gouache storybook illustration, thick ink outlines, saturated flat colors, absurd comedic energy, slightly surreal, consistent painterly texture

wings.name: Paleozoic
wings.hook: Paleo means old: the oldest wing, flooded with sea light.

wings.name: Mesozoic
wings.hook: Meso means middle: the middle wing, where the dinosaurs live.

wings.name: Cenozoic
wings.hook: Ceno sounds like 'scene, now': the newest wing, ending in the present.

loci.scene: A sunburned tourist fires an enormous flash camera while trilobites and Anomalocaris burst out of the sea like popcorn.
facts: The Cambrian explosion: most major animal groups appear in the fossil record.
Trilobites everywhere; Anomalocaris is the top predator.

imagePrompt.subject: A sunburned tourist in a Hawaiian shirt holding an enormous old-fashioned bellows camera, flash exploding
imagePrompt.action: photographing hundreds of trilobites and strange early sea creatures (Anomalocaris, Opabinia) bursting out of a turquoise sea like popcorn
imagePrompt.scene: a rocky primordial shoreline with bare land, no plants

loci.scene: A snooty diner orders fish; the waiter serves a jawless armored fish on a block of ice while the restaurant freezes solid.
facts: Sea life diversifies fast; early jawless fish appear.
Ends in an ice age and the second-largest mass extinction.

imagePrompt.subject: A snooty diner in a tuxedo with a monocle and a waiter in a white jacket
imagePrompt.action: the waiter proudly presents a silver platter holding a goofy armored jawless fish with no jaw (Arandaspis) sitting on a block of ice, while the diner gasps
imagePrompt.scene: a fancy restaurant that is freezing solid: icicles hanging from the chandelier, frost creeping over tables, other diners frozen in blocks of ice, nautiloid shells as table decorations

loci.scene: A silly clown plants the first tiny land plants on bare rock while a jawed fish bites his giant shoe.
facts: First vascular plants on land, such as tiny Cooksonia.
Jawed fish spread; big coral reefs grow.

imagePrompt.subject: A silly circus clown with a red nose, rainbow wig and enormous floppy shoes
imagePrompt.action: kneeling and planting tiny forked green twig plants (Cooksonia) one by one on completely bare grey rock with a toy watering can, while a toothy jawed fish leaps out of a tide pool and chomps on his giant shoe
imagePrompt.scene: a barren rocky coast with colorful coral reefs visible under clear shallow water

loci.scene: At an English cream tea, a fish with stubby legs crawls out of the teapot onto the scones while an armored Dunkleosteus pours.
facts: The Age of Fishes.
Fish with limb-like fins edge onto land; the first forests grow.

imagePrompt.subject: A proper English cream tea with scones, clotted cream and jam on a lace tablecloth
imagePrompt.action: a fish with stubby little legs (Tiktaalik) crawls out of the spout of a porcelain teapot onto the scones, while a huge armored fish (Dunkleosteus) wearing a lace bonnet pours tea from a second teapot
imagePrompt.scene: a garden of early tree-like plants (Archaeopteris), the first forest, around the tea table

loci.scene: An eagle-sized dragonfly in a miner's helmet hauls sacks of coal out of a towering fern swamp.
facts: Vast swamp forests later become coal.
High oxygen means giant insects like Meganeura; the first reptiles appear.

imagePrompt.subject: A gigantic dragonfly (Meganeura) as big as an eagle wearing a coal miner's helmet with a glowing headlamp
imagePrompt.action: flying out of a mine cart track carrying two heavy sacks of black coal, while a giant millipede (Arthropleura) pushes a mine cart full of coal
imagePrompt.scene: a towering steamy swamp forest of giant tree ferns and scale trees (Lepidodendron)

loci.scene: A Dimetrodon in curlers gets a perm while the salon hair dryers erupt like volcanoes and the place burns down.
facts: Pangaea is assembled; sail-backed synapsids like Dimetrodon.
Ends with the Great Dying: about 90% of marine species, linked to Siberian volcanism.

imagePrompt.subject: A sail-backed Dimetrodon wearing pink hair curlers sitting in a 1980s hair salon chair getting a perm
imagePrompt.action: the row of dome hood hair dryers erupts like volcanoes spewing lava and black smoke, the hairdresser screams, the salon is on fire
imagePrompt.scene: a garish 1980s hair salon with checkered floor, a world map on the wall showing one single supercontinent

loci.scene: A small early dinosaur pedals a tricycle across a single desert supercontinent with a tiny mammal in the basket.
facts: Life recovers from the Great Dying.
The first dinosaurs and the first mammals appear.

imagePrompt.subject: A small skinny early dinosaur (Coelophysis) wearing a bike helmet
imagePrompt.action: pedaling a child's red tricycle with great determination, a tiny shrew-like early mammal riding in the front basket with goggles
imagePrompt.scene: a vast hot red desert supercontinent with cycads and conifers, a cracked dry landscape stretching to the horizon

loci.scene: A jury of sauropods, necks through the ceiling, faces an Archaeopteryx judge as the courtroom floor splits in two.
facts: Giant sauropods, Stegosaurus and Allosaurus.
First birds (Archaeopteryx); Pangaea starts breaking apart.

imagePrompt.subject: A jury box filled with giant long-necked sauropod dinosaurs (Brachiosaurus, Diplodocus) whose necks smash up through the ceiling
imagePrompt.action: an Archaeopteryx in a white powdered judge's wig bangs a gavel, a Stegosaurus sits at the defendant's table, while the courtroom floor cracks and splits apart into two halves
imagePrompt.scene: a wood-paneled courtroom overgrown with ferns

loci.scene: A wooden crate bursts with the first flowers and a T. rex, just as an asteroid streaks in to smash it.
facts: Flowering plants appear and spread; T. rex and Triceratops.
Ends 66 Ma with the Chicxulub asteroid impact.

imagePrompt.subject: A giant wooden shipping crate bursting open with colorful flowers spilling out, a Tyrannosaurus rex and a Triceratops peeking out of it
imagePrompt.action: a flaming asteroid streaks down from the sky about to smash the crate, the dinosaurs look up in horror
imagePrompt.scene: a lush landscape with magnolia flowers, a volcanic horizon

loci.scene: Gene, the palest man alive, sunbathes as a whale on legs walks into the sea and dog-sized horses trot past.
facts: With the dinosaurs gone, mammals diversify.
Whales evolve from land mammals; early horses and primates.

imagePrompt.subject: An extremely pale, almost glowing white man with a mustache in an old-fashioned striped swimsuit, slathered in sunscreen, reclining in a deckchair
imagePrompt.action: beside him an early whale with four legs (Ambulocetus) waddles into the sea, and tiny dog-sized early horses (Eohippus) trot past his deckchair
imagePrompt.scene: a tropical beach with palm trees and a small primate watching from a tree

loci.scene: A blazing neon sign lights up the savanna at night as an upright-walking Australopithecus strolls past grazing horses.
facts: Grasslands spread and grazing mammals boom.
Early hominins such as Australopithecus walk upright.

imagePrompt.subject: A giant glowing Las Vegas style neon sign shaped like an arrow and stars, standing in an African grassland savanna at night
imagePrompt.action: an upright-walking early hominin (Australopithecus) strolls under the neon glow, while horses, antelopes and a giraffe graze on grass glowing in pink and cyan neon light

loci.scene: A giant silver quarter rolls down a glacier with a woolly mammoth and a cave person riding it. That's us: we live here.
facts: Repeated ice ages; woolly mammoths and sabre-toothed cats.
Homo sapiens appears. We are still in the Quaternary.

imagePrompt.subject: A giant shiny silver quarter coin rolling on its edge down a glacier like a wheel
imagePrompt.action: a woolly mammoth and a cheering cave person ride on top of the rolling coin, a sabre-toothed cat chases them
imagePrompt.scene: an ice age glacier with snowy mountains
